method: For the four original failures, try all connected edges within 30 m of each enabled mapped entrance within 10 m of the footprint; reject connectors intersecting more than 2.5 m of a building interior. This recovers Aurora entrance 216. When no qualifying entrance exists, use a separately estimated nearest unblocked building-edge connection, at most 30 m. Gold, Welch and University Towers remain estimates. Network and both site entrances are unchanged. These supplemental routes do not silently revise the frozen 36-building baseline averages or routine-route denominators.

rows.name: Aurora Hall
rows.unavailable_reason: Straight entrance connector intersects a building footprint
rows.access_basis: Original enabled GIS entrance; shortest unblocked connection within 30 m

rows.name: Gold Hall
rows.unavailable_reason: No enabled mapped entrance within 10 m of building footprint
rows.access_basis: Estimated nearest building-edge connection; no qualifying mapped entrance connection

rows.name: University Towers
rows.unavailable_reason: Mapped entrance more than 30 m from connected path network
rows.access_basis: Estimated nearest building-edge connection; no qualifying mapped entrance connection

rows.access_basis: Estimated nearest building-edge connection; no qualifying mapped entrance connection
